oneLiner: A warm 10–15 minute AI phone call with every applicant, not just the top 50 — so good people with bad resumes stop getting filtered out.

stages.name: Define what we're building
stages.goal: Agree exactly what the product does, who uses it, and what the demo shows.
known: Problem: resume screens drop ~900 of 1,000 applicants unheard; some are strong people with weak resumes.
Every applicant gets a warm phone call from a Bolna voice AI. No resume filter in front.
Call length: clearly weak candidates get a polite exit in 2–3 minutes; promising ones go up to 10 minutes max.
Upfront opening; candidate can reschedule. No “talk to a human” option at all — if asked, the AI explains this first chat is with it and carries on; never promises a callback.
AI politely cuts in on long answers or asks a follow-up; hard stop at 15 minutes.
Scored on skills, experience, confidence and culture fit. Weights and extra traits set per company (experts vs learners vs curious types).
Pick: No / Maybe / Good / Amazing, with evidence quotes. HR has the final say.
Extra flags: fits another role, culture standout, wants an internship, needs a human look.
Cost: ~₹85 per full 10-minute call, ~₹25 per short exit.
Different from HeyMilo / Hyring: we call everyone, spot other-role / culture / internship fit, and keep it a warm chat rather than a test.
Team of four: Shubh, Ankit, Tushar, and one on market research.
PRD v3 written: raw thoughts + both of Tushar's PRDs.
Shubh's latest decisions override earlier raw thoughts and both of Tushar's PRDs. Tushar's PRDs are not updated; PRD v3 is the master.

Added from Tushar's PRD: name check, Hindi/English switching, resume-mismatch flag, side-by-side view, spreadsheet export, data kept 90 days / 12 months, heads-up SMS, status board, HR login, bias watch, 5-minute demo, business case, tech setup and build plan (for stage 3).
open: TRAI number series for hiring calls
Should candidates see their own score?

stages.name: Edge cases
stages.goal: List every way a call or the pipeline can go wrong, and decide how we handle each.
known: Edge-case list started in PRD section 18; finish alongside the build.
open: Starter list to review (not agreed yet): no answer / voicemail, wrong number, call drops midway, bad network.
Candidate rambles, goes silent, asks “are you a bot?”, gets upset, or tries to negotiate salary.
Candidate wants Hindi or another language; heavy accent; background noise.
Candidate reschedules, then misses the rescheduled slot.
Bolna limit of 2 calls at a time vs 1,000 applicants.

stages.name: System architecture + SLD
stages.goal: Design the whole system and draw the system-level diagram. Built with Fable.
known: Architecture v1 written: one Next.js app on Vercel, Supabase (data, login, files, live updates), Claude for reading resumes and scoring, Bolna for the call.
Dispatcher runs every minute, keeps 2 calls in flight, retries up to 3 times, books reschedules.
Scores stored per quality (1–5 with quotes); overall and pick computed live, so rubric switches are instant.
9 build modules defined for subagents, each with skills needed and a 'done when' test.
Build spec written: exact database, every request in and out, verified Bolna details, interviewer script spec, AI outputs, screens, and one brief per build piece.
open: Day-1 Bolna checks: start-call fields, mid-call tool format, Hinglish voice, agent hanging up itself, raising the 2-call limit.
Remaining Bolna checks on the first test call: exact transcript/recording field names, Hinglish quality.

stages.name: Build with subagents
stages.goal: Split the architecture into independent pieces and build them in parallel with subagents.

decisions.text: Phone calls only — no Google Meet, no video.
Calls open by stating plainly that it’s about the job application.
Process: define → edge cases → architecture + SLD (Fable) → build with subagents.
No human-callback option; candidates talk only to the AI.
Rubric is per company, and always includes culture fit.
PRD v2 is the working spec; Tushar's PRD kept as reference.
Calls max 10 minutes; polite 2–3 minute exit for clearly weak candidates (replaces 10–15 minutes).
Every call starts with a name check. Tushar's extra items adopted into PRD v3.
AI answers honestly if asked whether it's an AI; recording not mentioned on calls (consent at application).
One standard rubric per job, edited by the company. English + Hinglish only. Talent pool in; candidate follow-ups out. Credits unlimited.
